text:
eli: FYI customer ACME (case #AC-9932) reporting huge latency spike on /v1/generate since 08:40 UTC. p95 jumped ~600ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~3.6s. Lots of 502/504s too.

priya: ack. Pulling the p95/p99 dashboards now. Any recent deploys to runtime or traffic shift? @maya can you check model routing?

maya: no prod deploys in last hour. I see a sudden increase in long-tail token counts for that tenant (avg seq len up 3x). KV cache hitrate dropped from 82% -> 42% for acme-prod routes.

jason: sounds like cache churn + larger sequences => more runtime work. We should follow the latency mitigation playbook: 1) tighten tenant rate limits to shed load, 2) enable circuit breaker for long requests, 3) route heavy requests to lower-cost/faster model variant, 4) enable region fallback to us-west as backup.

priya: doing step 1 now — applying temporary tenant throttle (50% of normal) for acme-prod via ratelimit service. Command: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/tenants/acme-prod/throttle -d '{"rate":200, "burst":50}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

ops-bot: throttle applied for tenant acme-prod -> 200rps (burst 50).

maya: enabling CB for /v1/generate for acme-prod to trip on 95th percentile > 1.2s. Config snippet applied: 
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "tenant": "acme-prod",
  "circuit_breaker": {"p95_threshold_ms": 1200, "consecutive_trips": 3, "cooldown_s": 120}
}
```

jason: also switching heavy traffic to fallback model variant now — redwood-mid-quant (lower seq perf but faster tail) and pinning to us-west region: 
- route acme-prod -> model:redwood-mid-quant@us-west
- disable KV cache bypass for new variant so we avoid cold KV thrash

eli: initial numbers after steps 1-3: p95 down to ~280ms, p99 ~650ms, error rates dropped 70%. Still higher than baseline but acceptable for customer.

priya: great. I'll notify support and customer with interim mitigation summary and ETA for rollback. We'll keep throttle + CB for 30m then slowly relax. can someone open an incident ticket and add repro artifacts?

maya: opening ticket INC-2026, attaching flamegraphs, traces, and request sample. Repro steps saved in ticket.

jason: follow-up action items: [1] investigate why KV cache hitrate dropped (cache key variance from prompt changes), [2] consider adaptive batching limits for long sequences, [3] add automatic fallback routing when tenant p95 > threshold, [4] run postmortem and update SLO guardrails docs.

eli: customer notified. They accepted mitigations and asked for a timeline. I'll own postmortem write-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: mitigation checklist completed (throttle, circuit-breaker, fallback routing). Next check in 15m.

maya: note — when we relax throttle, do it in stages and monitor KV warmup. If p99 regresses, re-enable routing to fallback automatically.

priya: agreed. I'll schedule a staged unthrottle: 200 -> 400 -> normal with 5m holds.

eli: closing thread for now, will update incident ticket with final metrics and RCA.
